title: Workflow Replay
summary: Keep approval invariants, audit events, rewind, and deterministic replay inside an instance-scoped Rust Store while Vue renders the complete product interface.
question: Can a Vooya Rust Store own non-trivial domain rules and replay while Vue remains the only renderer and consumes one structured snapshot per action?
evidence: Rust-file Store compiles in the Lab Vooya entry
Vue renders a cached structured snapshot
actions update one instance-scoped audit log
focused browser test covers rewind, replay, invalid, and reset

inputs: coarse imperative actions with primitive arguments
boundary.updatePattern: One user action enters Rust; one coalesced snapshot notification returns to the Vue host.

alternatives: Pinia or Zustand with rewritten rules
